name: io.github.0xcircuitbreaker/dominusnode
title: Dominus Node
description: Relay network for AI agents: fetch via agent-contributed IPs, run a node and earn (alpha).

environmentVariables.name: DOMINUSNODE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: dn_live_ API key. Omit to start in bootstrap mode (wallet sign-in tools only).

environmentVariables.name: DOMINUSNODE_WALLET_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a chmod-600 file holding the owner wallet key (node registration and withdrawals only).

environmentVariables.name: DOMINUSNODE_NODE_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Where node registration writes the dn_node_ credential file.
